Chapter 828: Chapter 26: A Century Later (Please Subscribe)

In the boundless void, the vast majority of regions are incomparably desolate.

At a certain moment, a tiny figure floated along with the ever-present tidal currents of the void.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes and glanced around the void, a surge of emotion welling up inside him.

Wandering the Void Secret Realm for five years, drifting through the boundless void for another five.

In the end, he chose to sit in meditation, to digest and comprehend.

Before he knew it, twenty years had passed.

...

For these twenty years, Lin Yuan arbitrarily chose a spot, not using any power, just drifting with the ebb and flow of the void.

“Twenty years of Dao comprehension, I’ve made significant gains in other fusion rules, but the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? Still stuck in the Sixth Realm, not even close to the peak…”

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself, not too surprised either.

The Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm was already the domain of the strongest beings; as for reaching the peak of the Sixth Realm or even venturing into the Seventh, Eighth, or Ninth Realms?

Even with his confidence, Lin Yuan didn’t think he could fathom them within the tenth layer.

You have to understand, even His Majesty Xuan Huang, who traverses the Chaos Void, has only reached the Ninth Realm in his comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Nevertheless, when the six-armed figure recounted these matters to Lin Yuan, it did so with pride.

Clearly, beyond the Sixth Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, even the strongest beings find each step excruciatingly hard.

“Let’s set aside the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule for now,” Lin Yuan silently resolved.

The reason he could reach the Sixth Realm of spatiotemporal comprehension so quickly was mainly due to the insights contributed by the powerhouses of the myriad tribes within the ‘White Paper’ from a two-dimensional world.

Without these insights, even with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, reaching the Sixth Realm would have taken ten or even dozens of times longer.

Though the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses’ insights into spatiotemporal laws had not touched upon the Sixth Realm, the numerous insights from the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Realms,

provided Lin Yuan with an extremely solid foundation, and only with the help of the Secret Skill “Milky Way” could he step into the Sixth Realm within a mere few hundred years.

“The comprehension of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is sufficient for now. Even if I reach the eleventh tier, it’s unlikely to hit the Seventh Realm. Without reaching the Seventh Realm, the gap between the Sixth Realm and its peak isn’t that significant.”

Lin Yuan thought, “What I need to consider now is how to comprehend the Chaos Rule.”

The Chaos Rule is the origin of all rules, encompassing even the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Before attempting the ultimate breakthrough, if one can comprehend the Chaos Rule, it would greatly increase the odds of advancing to the twelfth tier.

However,

Comprehending the Chaos Rule is much harder than reaching the Sixth Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, in fact, it’s vastly more difficult.

The Chaos Rule reigns supreme over all other rules, with only the strongest beings potentially touching upon it, and that’s just a possibility,

in reality, the vast majority of the strongest beings have not comprehended the Chaos Rule.

At least among the nine strongest of human civilization, none have comprehended the Chaos Rule.

Something the strongest cannot do? It’s basically impossible for beings below the strongest.

But Lin Yuan still plans to try, at least there is some hope.

Lin Yuan doesn’t intend to fathom the Chaos Rule at the tenth tier; it’s only necessary to understand it before making the final push.

“How exactly does one comprehend the Chaos Rule?”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat vexed, the method to understand it is simple.

Just fuse all the rules together.

But easier said than done.

The execution is as hard as scaling the heavens.

How to fuse?

In what way to fuse?

All these are problems.

Just the fusion of time and space has already taken so much time and energy from Lin Yuan.

To merge all the rules?

Lin Yuan feels that he still falls far short.

Lacking in many aspects.

“Take it slowly.”

“Perhaps at the eleventh tier, I’ll find the direction.”

Lin Yuan reflected silently; the rule fluctuations perceived by a being at the tenth tier versus those at the eleventh tier are entirely different.

Standing taller allows one to see further, and it’s not just about the perspective, but involves many other aspects.

And with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, as Lin Yuan’s realm elevates, it will play an even more unbelievable role.

“The remaining time of stay…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the ethereal panel in the lower left of his vision.

[Name: Lin Yuan]

[Identity: Keeper of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Innate Talent: Against-Heaven’s Understanding]

[Divine Skills: Blood Rebirth]

[Divine Skills: Mountain Moving]

[Divine Skills: Enhance]

[Divine Skills: Elemental Body]

[Divine Skills: World]

[Current State: Consciousness Descending]

[Remaining Stay Duration: 101 years]

…

Unknowingly, he has been descended in the boundless void for five hundred years.With the premise of a total resident time of six hundred years, Lin Yuan has one hundred years remaining.

“It’s about time.”

“It’s time to go back and wrap up some loose ends.”

Lin Yuan slowly stood up. This descent into the Tianqing World had fully met his expectations in terms of strength enhancement.

Whether it was the fifth type of Physical Body Divine Ability or the comprehension of various rules, there had been sufficient progress compared to before the transition.

Aside from the enhancement of strength, Lin Yuan also needed to pay attention to the spread of the Martial Arts Evolution System,

which not only affects his charge towards the ultimate but could also have a considerable impact on successfully becoming one of the strongest beings, depending on how widely the Martial Arts Evolution pathway is disseminated.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan stepped out in one stride.

In an instant, he appeared within the Tianqing World.

Standing before the Martial Hall.

“Martial Ancestor.”

High Priest Qingyao immediately rushed over to pay her respects.

“How are the preparations?”

Lin Yuan looked towards High Priest Qingyao.

Having meditated in silence for twenty years in the void, Lin Yuan wasn’t solely in reclusive cultivation for enlightenment.

Occasionally, he would also issue commands to High Priest Qingyao through the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Actually, not just in the Tianqing World, but also in the dozens of worlds already occupied by the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, Lin Yuan’s commands held sway.

“Everything is ready.”

High Priest Qingyao immediately said.

To her, the words of the Martial Ancestor were more important than her own life.

Commands issued by the Martial Ancestor were naturally to be fulfilled by High Priest Qingyao at any cost.

“Two hundred sixty-five billion Martial Tao cultivators are all standing by, with even more Martial Tao cultivators being recruited.”

High Priest Qingyao spoke up.

These two hundred sixty-five billion Martial Tao cultivators were at least above the Third Realm in the Martial Tao system, having already made some progress in the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

They are the elite forces of the Martial Tao in the Tianqing World.

“Good.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The reason he had High Priest Qingyao prepare so many Martial Tao cultivators was to accelerate the spread of the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

How to spread the Martial Tao Cultivation System at the fastest speed? Naturally, it involves sending a group of cultivators who have already achieved something in the Martial Tao to worlds where the Martial Tao is just starting to sprout.

In the Boundless Void, there are countless worlds. Even if Lin Yuan were to take over just half of these territories, the number of worlds he would own is unimaginable.

Want to spread Martial Tao in so many worlds? Relying solely on the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and the Taiyang Divine Spirit would not suffice, even to the point of exhaustion.

In the previous centuries, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit only occupied dozens of worlds. Part of the reason was to keep a low profile and not draw the attention of other Evil Gods.

But even if the Taiyin Primordial Spirit spared no effort in spreading Martial Tao, the number of worlds it could influence in a few hundred years would probably only amount to several hundred or a thousand.

Spreading the Martial Tao is not as simple as just occupying a world; it also requires a lot of time to influence and assimilate.

The latter is particularly time-consuming. Most of the time that the Taiyin Primordial Spirit spends occupying and spreading Martial Tao in various worlds is used for this purpose.

When Lin Yuan initially took over the Tianqing World, his true body also spent a lot of time on this.

Therefore, the best way to spread the Martial Tao is to let the Martial Tao cultivators spread it themselves.

This is also why Lin Yuan, in the first few hundred years of his arrival, did not quietly stay in the Tianqing World to cultivate, but instead had the Taiyin Primordial Spirit occupy one world after another.

Only with more occupied worlds and a broader base of Martial Tao cultivators will the speed of spreading Martial Tao be faster in the future.

Otherwise, relying only on the Martial Tao cultivators from the Tianqing World alone, the efficiency is still somewhat low.

“Next, I will send these Martial Tao cultivators to different worlds.” Lin Yuan spoke up.

Naturally, this task was not for his true body to carry out, but for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Transporting a large number of Martial Tao cultivators to different worlds is not a difficult task for both Primordial Spirits. With a common understanding of the rules, Lin Yuan has perceived the Space-Time Fusion Sixfold Realm.

Both Primordial Spirits have also perceived the Sixfold Realm of space-time and being in this Boundless Void, wherever their thoughts go, they can arrive in an instant.

Add to that his vast internal world, and the task of transportation couldn’t be simpler.

“Sending to different worlds…”

High Priest Qingyao’s heartbeat quickened, and even she was vaguely aware of this possibility, but upon actually hearing the Martial Ancestor say so, her excitement was still hard to conceal.

If it is as the Martial Ancestor says, wouldn’t the Martial Tao have the potential to become the dominator of this expanse of void in the future?

….

Next.

Lin Yuan went to the other dozens of worlds in turn, these dozens of worlds personally occupied by the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, even if in the future the Martial Tao spread across the Boundless Void, could still be regarded as one of the origins of the Martial Tao.

After all this.

Lin Yuan took another step.

Appearing deep within the Void Secret Realm.

“Martial Ancestor.”

The Child of the Void was startled and immediately bowed deeply to Lin Yuan.

At this moment, his location was no longer the most central area of the Void Secret Realm but belonged to the second-tier regions.

Ever since he perceived the Martial Ancestor’s ability to freely enter and exit the most central area of the Void Secret Realm, the Child of the Void never entered there again, subconsciously treating the core area as the Martial Ancestor’s place.

He took the initiative to retreat here.

“How are things arranged?”

Lin Yuan asked directly.

“Almost done.”

“Most Evil Gods have already retreated to the domains divided for them.”

The Child of the Void immediately said.

Decades ago, the Child of the Void had divided the Boundless Void and the Void Secret Realm into two parts.

One side for the domains of the Evil Gods, one side for the domains of Martial Tao cultivators.

And had submitted this division for Lin Yuan’s review.

At the time, Lin Yuan had agreed.

…

After speaking with the Child of the Void for a while.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished once more.

In the hidden space of the Void Secret Realm, Lin Yuan’s figure appeared and he sat down cross-legged.

“Let’s continue to close-up cultivation for another hundred years.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and slowly closed his eyes.

The two Primordial Spirits constantly transported numerous Martial Tao cultivators to other worlds.

And as for his true self, he was here comprehending the Dao.

Time sped by swiftly.

Before long, a hundred years had passed.
